cases.description: a walking wand fighter presses once and releases: one cast, one pause before the shot lands
cases.name: wand-single-shot

cases.description: the trigger held for three cycles: the pause repeats with each cast
cases.name: wand-held

cases.description: a second press while the wand is still cooling down is released before it can start: the server never pauses for it and delivers no windup
cases.name: wand-rejected-cooldown

cases.description: a sword hit staggers the wand fighter during the cast: the cast and its pause are cancelled and a stagger fx says so
cases.name: wand-staggered

cases.description: the stagger lands while the release pause is already running: the pause must end at the stagger, not at the shot
cases.name: wand-staggered-in-pause

cases.description: a weapon swap during the cast cancels it without any cancel fx: only the self block's weapon changes
cases.name: wand-weapon-swap

cases.description: a walking bow fighter presses once and releases: the server pauses for the release, but a bow draw delivers no windup fx
cases.name: bow-single-shot

cases.description: a walking sword fighter swings: a player's swing has no wind-up, so the windup fx says 0 ms and the server never pauses
cases.name: sword-swing
